description: Which wallets has this X (Twitter) account published? Looks the handle up in our index of Polymarket profiles that name an X account, read every 2 hours from Polymarket's public leaderboards and never pruned (indexSince says from when): each wallet (Polygon) with its Polymarket name, when we first and last saw it, and a profile link. Absence means not seen yet, not that the account has no wallet. No X access. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.
name: x_handle_wallets
